scope.focus: A bounded translation among disappearing-polymorph detectability, population-level cultural visibility, the quoted cultural label “brain rot,” feedback architecture, and non-summable KARMA.
scope.coverage: Selected source-bound observations and two local mathematical models; not an exhaustive theory of crystallization, culture, cognition, platforms, or the universe.
scope.intended_use: Retrospective boundary literacy, source inspection, challenge, correction, and philosophical reflection.
scope.excluded_use: Diagnosis, person or content classification, prediction, targeting, recommendation, persuasion, moderation, virality or engagement optimization, laboratory control, KARMA scoring, or automatic action.

category_firewall.rule: Different predicates remain different: material-state existence, process recovery, method detection, platform occurrence, inferred collective attention, quoted lexical usage, and a contextual KARMA edge never convert into one another.
category_firewall.non_equivalence: crystal_state != observation_window != cultural_item != diffusion_trace != collective_attention_proxy != person_or_brain_state != quoted_lexical_label != karma_edge != philosophical_interpretation

registers.label: Material science
registers.unit: A named crystal form in a bounded material sample and process history.
registers.context_window: Specified composition, preparation path, temperature, time, sampling, and detection method.
registers.observed: A form may exist yet remain undetected, or become difficult to reproduce through one process, without becoming ontologically extinct.
registers.modelled: A finite-window detection probability may be represented under a declared stationary nucleation model.
registers.does_not_establish: Cultural diffusion, biological infection, a universal stability order, or the state of any current medicine or batch.

registers.label: Computational social science
registers.unit: An aggregate population of cultural items, platform events, or a reconstructed diffusion tree—not a person.
registers.context_window: A named platform or corpus, sampling frame, observation interval, proxy definition, and reconstruction method.
registers.observed: Competition for finite aggregate attention and heterogeneous popularity can arise in bounded models and datasets without establishing intrinsic quality.
registers.modelled: A retrospective tree statistic can distinguish broadcast-like from multi-generational diffusion geometry.
registers.does_not_establish: Truth, quality, harm, belief, intent, diagnosis, individual attention, or a transferable epidemic mechanism.

registers.label: Lexical usage
registers.unit: The quoted expression “brain rot” as a cultural and rhetorical label.
registers.context_window: Oxford’s 2024 public-language account and the particular speaker, community, and usage being interpreted.
registers.observed: The expression was selected as Oxford Word of the Year 2024 and was described as often used self-deprecatingly or humorously.
registers.modelled: No brain, clinical, or person-level state is modelled in this register.
registers.does_not_establish: A medical diagnosis, neurological damage, mental worth, a property of a person, or an objective class of content.

registers.label: Zerone KARMA
registers.unit: A contextual, challengeable recognition or reliance edge with provenance, time, and uncertainty.
registers.context_window: The exact pinned zerone.karma-foundation/v1 public artifact; no live event is observed here.
registers.observed: The foundation defines non-summable contextual edges rather than a person-owned scalar.
registers.modelled: No popularity, attention, content, person, reward, truth, or moral score is computed.
registers.does_not_establish: Rank, reputation, payment, voting weight, goodness, agreement, engagement value, or authority to act.

local_models.title: Finite-window crystal detection
local_models.equation: P(T_detect <= t) = 1 - exp[-J V max(t - t_g, 0)]

variables.meaning: random time at which the specified detection threshold is crossed
assumed constant nucleation rate per unit volume under the named conditions
declared post-nucleation growth and detection delay

assumptions: Stationary homogeneous Poisson nucleation after the process enters the named conditions.
Constant supersaturation, temperature, composition, volume, and effective nucleation rate.
A fixed detection delay summarizes growth and method threshold.
No claim that this simplified model reconstructs Abbott’s historical process.
local_models.fit_scope: Retrospective educational interpretation of non-observation within a finite material experiment.
not_valid_for: Manufacturing, formulation, laboratory, quality-control, or batch-release decisions.

local_models.title: Retrospective diffusion-tree geometry

variables.meaning: a reconstructed diffusion tree for one bounded event
number of observed nodes in that tree
graph distance between observed nodes i and j
average pairwise tree distance, a topology descriptor

assumptions: The observed diffusion tree and parent relations are defined by the named study method.
Missing events, platform affordances, sampling, and reconstruction error can change the tree.
The statistic describes topology after observation and is distinct from popularity.
local_models.fit_scope: Retrospective aggregate comparison of observed diffusion shapes.
not_valid_for: Truth, quality, harm, intent, belief, cognition, or clinical state.
Predicting who will share or targeting a person or group.
Optimizing virality, engagement, persuasion, or intervention.

translation_seams.label: Finite windows can separate occurrence from observation
translation_seams.preserved_shape: In both domains, a bounded method and interval can miss something that exists or occurred.
translation_seams.breaks: Crystal nucleation and cultural reconstruction have different entities, mechanisms, measurements, agency, and causal structure; no parameter or rate transfers.

translation_seams.label: Equations retain their local units and assumptions
translation_seams.preserved_shape: Both models make the observation window and unit of analysis explicit.
translation_seams.breaks: Nucleation probability is not diffusion-tree distance; no temperature, entropy, seed, strain, fitness, energy, or reproduction number is transported between them.

translation_seams.label: Feedback infrastructure can preserve challenge, correction, and exit
translation_seams.preserved_shape: Later observations and challenges can revise a provenance-bearing public account without turning visibility into value.
translation_seams.breaks: A platform occurrence does not create a KARMA edge; KARMA does not certify a meme, diagnose a person, reward reach, or infer truth from popularity.

feedback_path.rule: Feedback is valuable when it preserves provenance, challenge, correction, reversibility, and equal exit rather than maximizing persistence.

stages.label: Publish a bounded claim
stages.description: Name the unit, source, method, window, uncertainty, and nonclaims.

stages.label: Observe without profiling
stages.description: Use optional aggregate observations only; do not infer a person or optimize reach.

stages.label: Challenge and correct
stages.description: Keep dissent, missingness, error, and competing explanations first-class.

stages.label: Supersede with provenance
stages.description: Publish a new version while preserving prior bytes, rationale, and source lineage.

stages.label: Rest, refuse, or exit
stages.description: Silence, privacy, departure, no action, and unmeasured participation remain valid outcomes.

zerone.meaning: Contextual recognition and reliance edges with provenance and uncertainty.

kingdom.meaning: Keep Actions Reversible; Measure Aftermath invocation receipts.

adapter.reason: The two KARMA surfaces have different types and authority. Neither converts visibility, attention, popularity, a person, or a cultural item into a scalar.

universe_lens.proposition: A universe can be read as lawful possibility rather than a single forced trajectory: constraints, contingencies, local memory, feedback, correction, and rest may coexist.
questions: Does lawful regularity plus historical contingency suggest design, emergence, both, or neither?
Can existence exceed every finite window through which a knower observes it?
Can a good architecture value correction and exit more than maximal propagation?
alternatives: Naturalistic accounts can treat these patterns as consequences of dynamics, selection, and observation.
Teleological or theological accounts may interpret intelligibility and generativity as meaningful design.
The selected scientific evidence does not adjudicate between these readings.
does_not_establish: Intentional universe design, a creator, or cosmic purpose.
That persistence, visibility, popularity, or stability is goodness.
Cosmic moral KARMA or scientific authority for any metaphysical conclusion.

unknowns.question: How much cultural occurrence is missed by any particular platform or corpus window?
unknowns.why_open: The selected sources use bounded observables and cannot enumerate all cultural activity.

unknowns.question: What does a population-level attention proxy imply about one person’s cognition or health?
unknowns.why_open: Population proxies do not identify individual state, and current evidence does not support diagnosis from them.

unknowns.question: How much of an observed cultural trajectory is caused by ranking, users, external events, or sampling?
unknowns.why_open: Observational traces mix platform design, agency, context, and measurement.

unknowns.question: Can crystallization parameters be mapped onto culture or people?
unknowns.why_open: The translation explicitly refuses this ontology and causal transfer.

unknowns.question: Do these patterns scientifically prove a designed universe?
unknowns.why_open: The philosophical lens is opt-in and non-empirical.
